description: This file is a shell script for testing Git's pack-objects functionality with various options such as --stdin-packs, --filter, --revs, and more. It defines test cases for different scenarios including setup, exclusions,loose objects, broken links, shared repositories, and error conditions, using functions and git commands to verify expected behaviors.

methods.name: packed_objects
methods.description: Lists the object IDs contained in a pack file by showing the index and extracting object IDs.

methods.name: objects_in_packs
methods.description: Returns sorted object IDs contained in given pack files or pack indexes.
